info.title: Get FBT MCF Order Status
info.description: This API allows you to query the status of **MCF Orders**. When an order has not been shipped, the `consign_orders` field will contain no data; once the order has been shipped, the `consign_orders` field will display the consignment details of the order. If a single package cannot accommodate the entire order (due to carrier restrictions or packaging size limitations), the **FBT** system will split the order into multiple packages for fulfillment, in which case the `consign_orders` field will contain multiple entries corresponding to the respective packages.

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: mcf_order_id
parameters.description: A unique ID that identifies different MCF orders

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

mcf_order_id.description: A unique ID that identifies different MCF orders

id.description: Identifier for goods generated by Fulfilled by TikTok systemgoods id

quantity.description: The goods quantity in this consign order

goods.description: The goods id and quantity in this consign order.

tracking_number.description: The tracking number of this consign order. If the order has not yet been handed over to the logistics carrier, this field may be a null value.

carrier.description: The shipping carrier of this consign order. If the order has not yet been handed over to the logistics carrier, this field may be a null value.

status.description:
The status of this consign order

Possible Status Enumerations
1. **PENDING** - Order is pending warehouse processing
2. **HANDLE_BY_WAREHOUSE** - Order is being processed by the warehouse
3. **SHIPPED** - Order has been shipped out from the warehouse
4. **HANDOVER** - Order has been received by the logistics carrier and is in transit
5. **CLOSED** - Order has been closed
6. **LOST** - Order is lost
7. **DAMAGE** - Order is damaged
8. **COMPLETED** - Order has been completed
9. **ABNORMAL** - There is an issue related to this order and cannot be fulfilled

is_platform_closed.description: This field indicates whether a consign order has been canceled by the FBT platform. If the value is true, it means the order has been canceled by the platform; if it is false, it means the order has been canceled by your OMS.

issue.description: This field displays the reason for order stalling. When a `consign order` is in an abnormal status (such as **ABNORMAL**, **LOST**, etc.), specific issue reasons will be shown here.

shipping_provider.description: The shipping carrier detailed informatioin of this consign order. If the order has not yet been handed over to the logistics carrier, this field may be a null value.

consign_orders.description: Once the order has been shipped, the `consign_orders` field will display the consignment details of the order.

create_time.description: The time when the mcf order is created
